_comment: Crops on farmland (ADR 0022), Minecraft 1.20 rules. ages = growth stages (0..ages-1, the last is ripe); looks = material per age; seed = item that plants it; drops_ripe / drops_young = drop lists like mining.json; frost_c = the crop dies back when its column is colder than this (ADR 0061, default 0 C; hardy crops lower) (binomial [n, p] = Minecraft's n extra tries at p, the 'apply_bonus' of its loot tables). random_tick_speed blocks per 16^3 section per 20 Hz tick (Minecraft gamerule default 3); hydration: water within radius blocks horizontally, at the farmland's height or one above.
